responsibility: Implements the core data structures and mutable state behind Rust name resolution in GCC. This file defines ribs and stacked scopes for names, types, labels, and macros; insertion and duplicate-checking of CanonicalPath bindings; reference tracking from uses to definitions; initialization of builtin type entries; storage and lookup of resolved names/types/labels/misc items; module-scope stack management; and closure-capture bookkeeping that records which outer variable declarations are captured by nested closures.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementation of the shared resolution machinery declared in the header: Rib and Scope operations, Resolver construction, builtin-type setup, resolved-reference maps, scope/rib lookup behavior, module-scope stack handling, and closure-capture tracking. It differs from rust-name-resolver.h by supplying the mutable algorithms and storage behavior behind those abstractions instead of their declarations.
